SELECT member_id, display_name, profile_image_url, preferred_language, preferred_currency_code, member_status, (onboarding_completed_at IS NOT NULL) AS onboarding_completed, (deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS deleted FROM members WHERE member_id = #{memberId} LIMIT 1

SELECT m.member_id, m.display_name, m.profile_image_url, m.preferred_language, CASE WHEN COALESCE(att.confirmed_count, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(att.attended_count * 100.0 / att.confirmed_count) END AS completion_rate, COALESCE(att.no_show_count, 0) AS no_show_count, AVG(CASE WHEN rs.deleted_at IS NULL THEN rs.rating END) AS average_rating, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mr.deleted_at IS NULL AND mr.visibility_status = 'VISIBLE' THEN mr.review_id END) AS review_count FROM members m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT am.member_id, SUM(am.attendance_status IN ('ATTENDED','NO_SHOW')) AS confirmed_count, SUM(am.attendance_status = 'ATTENDED') AS attended_count, SUM(am.attendance_status = 'NO_SHOW') AS no_show_count FROM appointment_members am WHERE am.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY am.member_id ) att ON att.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN appointment_members reviewed_am ON reviewed_am.member_id = m.member_id AND reviewed_am.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN member_reviews mr ON mr.reviewed_appointment_member_id = reviewed_am.appointment_member_id AND mr.deleted_at IS NULL AND mr.visibility_status = 'VISIBLE' LEFT JOIN member_review_scores rs ON rs.review_id = mr.review_id WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY m.member_id, m.display_name, m.profile_image_url, m.preferred_language, att.confirmed_count, att.attended_count, att.no_show_count LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM currencies WHERE currency_code = #{currencyCode} AND is_active = TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL )
